review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability; this harness derives every field from the recorded log, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR, a second production run of the world-container import path over the installation plus the spawn over c3's own geometry (m01-c3-world-residuals-census.json), and the owner-command smoke's own report.json and framebuffer captures (smoke/). Claim is implemented only. MEASURED, from the owner-supplied decrypted image (sha256 43540fc97347210d6f4c10b77edbd4cdab1f03d57554d638223c2430a6c37d75, image base 0x400000) and the production readers: (a) cls_zbd.c's node pass rewrites the stored word at [node+0x70] into a pointer to one of the record's own stored boxes (0x4e2a7c-0x4e2aa6, inverse at 0x4e19e6-0x4e1a1a), so the narrow phase (0x4cd960) copies the record's own box — the box the stored selector word names; (b) cls_di.c's intersection walk reads the record's flags word at 0x4cb635 and reaches that copy only with bit 0x40 set, otherwise descending into the record's children (0x4cb63c); (c) a grid record that binds no mesh stores exactly one of two things — nothing at all (148 records over the eight containers, resolved None by task #771) or a box only in the third slot its own selector word names (219 records, 47 of them in c3), which is task #771's measured 'grouping node' class; every one of the 219 grouping records keeps bit 0x40 clear and has children, so the walk never tests its box and nothing measured reports a contact for the record itself. The arm resolves those records to WorldCollisionRole::None under f18-world.grid-grouping-node-never-blocks with an explicit unknown shape; a record of the same store class storing the bit would keep f18-world.grid-grouping-node-role-unmeasured and be counted open (none exists here). 75 collision roles are still open across the eight containers and c3's spawn reports 0 unknown_mesh skips; M01's launch plan resolves label M01 to zbd/c3/m01/zbd/c3 with world_geometry satisfied and 0 gaps. All of it is code-derived static analysis plus byte censuses, observed_tool and never verified_original. The owner-command smoke opened the real window for 45 s of simulated time and wrote 12 framebuffer captures; it reports passed = true and its failures are recorded as measured: [world_terrain_lit; hud_objective_matches]. LIMITS OF WHAT WAS MEASURED, each recorded in docs/findings/2026-10-18-m01-c3-world-residuals.md and named here with the content it affects and the task that can lift it: (1) The 47 grouping records' children are not imported: this flat WorldDefinition owns the records the world node names, and a grouping node's children (54 of the 186 bind a mesh) sit one level below it. Role None is what the record states — its own box is never tested and it draws nothing — and is not a claim that the place it groups is passable. Affected content: the collision and presentation of everything a town_*/studebaker*/trucker*/tikicave/... record groups inside M01's world. Resolving task: none filed; it is the same part-hierarchy design question #1553 recorded for every model instance in every container. (2) What the 2000 renderer drew for a mesh-less grouping node was not observed: this task answers what the container states. Affected content: the presentation of the 219 grouping records. Resolving task: #358 (an owner-supplied original run). (3) f18-world.intersection-query-gameplay-consumer-unmeasured: which gameplay query consumes cls_di.c's intersection walk was not established (task #771). Affected content: every claim about what the original used the walk for; no conversion decision depends on it. Resolving task: #358. The 4 assertions discovered under this task's own prefix are the tests of this report. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
